notes:
Read-only static inventory of the working tree; another team is editing, so line numbers may drift. Nothing was run. Corrections to the brief: (1) A global win-tier ladder already exists: continuous winFeel curve (src/machines/_base/tiers.ts:95-147), TIER_SHOW and celebrate escalation (src/machines/_base/juice.ts:84-93, 150-292), winBurst tier branches (src/core/fx.ts:171-245), winSfx mapping (src/core/audio/sfx.ts:966-978). The missing parts are the layer above it (HUD banner, streak layer). (2) Coin shower exists (coinShower sfx.ts:321; 60-coin fountain juice.ts:218+; coinRain loop sfx.ts:875; jackpot rain). (3) Screen flash exists (core/fx.ts:122-133) with a reduceFlashing guard. (4) Pitch escalation exists in the gamble ladder (gambleFx.ts:26-30), the charm proc tick (charmProc.ts:28-30) and per-machine chimes, but not on streaks. (5) Anticipation exists (nearMiss juice.ts:315; bigone tease bigone/index.ts:531-557; tensionRise has about 17 call sites) but there is no time dilation before a reveal.

How the moments feel now (code level). Small x1-3: win1 sfx, 8 coins, glow, a world pop that flies to the wallet, HUD centre pop, numberTick on arrival. Medium x3-10: 14 coins, sparks, light pulse, coinShower, win2 (long, slow-mo-able), flash alpha 0.26-0.46, pour 16-38 coins. Big x10-25: 40 + 60 coins, shake, hit-stop 0.06, gold flash, HUD gold burst and shake, feed line, 3 s marquee and bulbs. Huge x25-50: winBurst huge (100 coins over 2 s, 80 confetti, zoom punch, hit-stop 0.08) plus 60-coin fountain, 0.4 s slow-mo at 40 percent, winRise, delayed gold flash, 5 s show. Mega x50+: huge burst plus 120-piece confetti volley, chroma, zoom, 16 pit-light strobe pulses, 7 s show. Jackpot: paper flash, gold tint 1.6 s, chroma, 200 coins over 3 s, pit-wide gold wave, bells, coin-rain loop, six 24-coin waves, hit-stop 0.12, 6 s show. Loss: 5 dust, shake 0.006, red pop, lose sfx (deliberately quiet). Near-miss: heartbeat, red pulse, zoom 1.5 percent, vignette 0.45, lamps 7 Hz over about 0.9 s, no dilation. Hot, cold, overheat: chip hop only. Heat: invisible. Wallet count: silent roll. Spend: silent bump. Charm proc: pitch tick by tier, gold pop, burst and shake. Gamble ladder: pitch +2 to +26 semitones per rung, coins by pot. PLAY burst: complete 1.55 s sequence with no hit-stop. Hands: bob, sway and Q coin tricks only.

Cost: screen-space effects are a few uniform writes or one tween each. Particles are 7 instanced draw calls with caps totalling 1728. popText is one draw call. Light pulses rescan the scene at most every 500 ms (src/core/fx/layer.ts:168-177). Audio has 32 voices with priority steal and a per-name limiter. The only budget pressure is the coin emitter at jackpot (gap above).

Possible duplicate: a local win shows a world pop flying to the wallet (juice.ts celebrate via popText flyTo) and a HUD centre pop with the same amount (src/menu/hud.ts:266-276 and :356-366). Check whether this reads as layering before adding a third number.

Constraints for any new proposal: online play clamps slow-mo to >=0.6 and hit-stop to <=0.12 (core/fx.ts:142, 158). Flashes must go through fx.flash (reduceFlashing, core/fx.ts:122-133). Shake must go through settings.shake (core/fx.ts:118). Settings has no particle, audio or hit-stop intensity knob (core/settings.ts:20-23).
